title: search arm 0 pendingDup visibility root cause
summary: The bench search arm scored 0% on real LoCoMo multi-session data because 17/19 session notes were pendingDup-flagged and retrieval-invisible in the main daemon's overlay. Mechanism: the write-time dup guard in routes/overlay.js fires when title-vector cosine >= 0.70 between a new note and any existing note, marking the new note pending_dup=true via overlayStore.markPendingDup(). The search path in routes/graph.js:146-149,301 calls dupInvisible() on every candidate, which delegates to judge.pendingDupState() (lib/judge.js:486-492) and filters the note out while it is within the judging timeout window. LoCoMo sessions from the same conversation discuss the same people/topics, so their title-vecs have mutual cosine >= 0.70, causing the dup guard to fire on bulk ingest and mark 17/19 notes invisible. The search arm called run_search(base_url=main_daemon) which hit the stale overlay with pendingDup={17 entries}, returning 0 results -> 0 context -> 0% accuracy. Fix (commit e9b1fd4, already merged): run_probe() in bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py now starts one shared embedded daemon (fresh overlay from graph-store, pendingDup={}) for both our-way and search arms. All 19 notes are visible to the embedded daemon. The search arm now calls run_search(emb_url, ...) instead of run_search(base_url, ...). The fix also added WORKSPACE-SKIP logic in _ingest_candidates_into_daemon() to detect when notes are already present (from main-daemon ingestion) and skip re-ingest, avoiding dup-guard re-fires and subsumption of existing notes. A separate cosine-floor bug (lib/embed.js best=0, routes/graph.js !(score>0)) was independently fixed by merging orch/attempt/fix-distill-search-floor.
